title: CIVIL RIGHTS, IMMIGRATION, SOCIAL SERVICES, AND NEIGHBORHOODS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to relative to evaluating the impacts of Executive Order 14224 on…
text:
[Council File 26-1386]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
CIVIL RIGHTS, IMMIGRATION, SOCIAL SERVICES, AND NEIGHBORHOODS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to relative to evaluating the impacts of Executive Order 14224 on the City in connection with assisting City residents with limited English proficiency (LEP).
Recommendation for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Raman – Blumenfield):
INSTRUCT the Community Investment Department, Civil + Human Rights and Equity Department, City Administrative Officer (CAO), Chief Legislative Analyst (CLA), and other Departments as deemed appropriate, to report on the impacts Executive Order 14224 has on the City of Los Angeles and how the City can use its resources to help fill in a gap that Angelenos need with said report to include, but not be limited to, the feasibility of City Departments to add translations for the now English-only federal resources to their websites.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the CAO nor the CLA has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Directs several city departments to report on how a federal executive order making federal resources English-only affects residents with limited English, including whether city websites could add translations.

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 21, 2026)
